integrity: Standalone exact finite checks supplement a proof covering all integer ranks >=2; rank-four construction checks candidate maps but is not exhaustive over all permutations.
scientific_limitations: Finite elementary-abelian characteristic-two transposition family only; no classification of general tau-groups or general finite cycle-set automorphisms. The full 2016 Rump text was unavailable and independent priority verification has not been performed.
title: Wreath-product automorphism groups of binary transposition \(\tau\)-cycle sets
